title: custom:tile-card-pro
description: One entity (or none) as a tile, drawn the way its poster type says: the icon (a type's animated one), the name, one line under it with the value, the status and the secondary, and controls at the line's end. What needs a second row is asked for: a slider below (control), the type's picture (show_picture), a plot of the history (visual). The poster type is detected from the entity (its domain, then its device class) or set with `poster`; its own keys sit flat on the card. Strings containing {{ }} are Jinja templates rendered by Home Assistant (name, secondary, icon, color, value, status, icon_image).

poster.description: The poster type, forced or one that is never detected (trend, grid, solar, car, appliance). Left out: detected from the entity's domain and device class; `entity` turns every default off

variant.description: How the type draws its subject: wind (dots, lines, swoosh, vectors) and rain (drops, ripples, fill) make the whole poster the animated field; cover (shutter, blind, curtain, garage, gate, awning, window; default: the device class) and appliance (pump, washer, dryer, dishwasher, heat_pump) pick the drawing

direction.description: wind, rain: the direction sensor (degrees or a compass point)

wind.description: rain: the wind speed that slants the drops

charging.description: car: charging (a binary sensor, or power: on above 0)

running_above.description: appliance: the power (W) above which it runs

series.description: trend: the series, ids or objects (entity, name, color, rules, visibility)

status.description: The status on the line after the value: its text (a template allowed), or false for none. Default: the poster type's status, else the matching rule's label; left out where it only repeats the value

icon_image.description: A picture in the icon: an image URL, a template that renders one, or an entity whose picture it shows. Without a picture now, the icon is `icon`'s

visual.description: A picture below the line: a plot of the history, a bar or a gauge of the value (a second row); glow (the tile lit from below in its colour, as strong as its level: min to max, a light's brightness, or on / off; a light's default); or none

control_position.description: Where the control sits: at the line's end, or below it. The icon's own actions are icon_tap_action / icon_hold_action

icon_ring.description: A ring of the value (min to max) around the icon

icon_tap_action.description: Run when the icon is tapped; toggle is the card's own (a lock locks or unlocks, an alarm panel arms or disarms, the rest switch). Default: none, a tap on the icon is the poster's

icon_hold_action.description: Run when the icon is held, a filling ring confirms it. Default: toggle on a lock and an alarm panel (none when it wants a code), else none

icon_double_tap_action.description: Run on a double tap of the icon

show_picture.description: The poster type's picture below the line (a weather or sun curve, solar production, a trend's lines); it takes a second row

vertical.description: The icon on top, the name and the value with its status centred under it, the controls under them; as narrow as its controls let it be, two rows at least. The poster type's line under the value is left out (a written `secondary` stays)

tileKeys.description: The tile's item: an entity's keys, less the picture and the control's place, which are the tile's own (visual, control_position)

tileRule.description: First matching rule wins, in the order written. Besides the colour, icon and label it changes the tile's icon; a key it writes wins over the card's

icon_image.description: A picture in the icon while the rule matches, or false for the icon

icon_ring.description: A ring of the value around the icon
